description.value:
Requirement The target is willing.

Range touch

Duration until your next daily preparations

You and the target share a single Vitae pool equal to the higher of your two normal caps, refreshed together at your next shared daily preparations. Either of you may spend from it; a Bloom triggered by either of you is rolled once and affects only the one who triggered it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Additionally This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. SpecialResource is declared per-actor with no cross-actor linking field in its schema, so nothing lets two actors' resource pools reference the same value either.
